info.title: FIDScript WhatsApp API
info.description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, manage groups, chats, profile and instance lifecycle. Authenticate every request with `X-API-Key: fidscript_live_…`. All responses use `{ success, data?, error? }`.

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: Send WhatsApp messages of every type

get.description: Confirm an API key is active and resolve the owning client. No side effects — ideal for a connection test.
Aggregate API usage for the authenticated client: requests today/this month, sends this month, token spend, and failed requests.
The machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 document for the entire API. Import into Postman, Insomnia, or an AI agent. A YAML mirror is at /api/v1/openapi.yaml.

post.description: Send a plain-text WhatsApp message.

to.description: Phone number in international format, no +.

post.description: Send an image, video, document or audio file by URL.

media_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the media.

post.description: Share a geographic location pin.
Share one or more contact cards.
React to an existing message (emoji).

key.description: The key of the message to react to.

reaction.description: A single emoji, or empty to remove.

post.description: Send an interactive poll.

selectableCount.description: How many options a voter may pick.

post.description: Send an interactive list message with selectable sections.
Send a native WhatsApp voice message (PTT) from an audio URL.

audio.description: Public HTTPS URL of the audio (prefer .ogg/opus for PTT).

post.description: Send a WhatsApp sticker from an image URL.

sticker.description: Public HTTPS URL of a .webp sticker image.

post.description: Post a status/story update (text, image, or audio).

content.description: Text for text/audio, or a media URL for image.

allContacts.description: true = all contacts, false = use statusJidList.

statusJidList.description: Recipient phone numbers (when allContacts is false).
